title: The inner conflict: another law in the members
english: I see another law in my members fighting against the law of my mind and leading me captive in the law of sin (Romans 7:23). Unhappy man that I am! Who will free me from the body of this death? (Romans 7:24)
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Paul is speaking in his own voice, describing the inner conflict between the law of the mind and the law of sin in his members.

title: Thanksgiving for deliverance through Christ
english: Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, I myself serve the law of God with my mind, but with my flesh I serve the law of sin. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Paul, having cried out for deliverance from the body of death, now gives thanks to God through Jesus Christ and states his divided service.
